name: falabella-mcp
description: Falabella Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, update_listing, set_inventory, end_list

platform_mcp_falabella_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_API_KEY
platform_mcp_falabella_api_key.description: Seller Center API key (Mi Cuenta > Integraciones / API in Falabella Seller Center). Signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the name-sorted, RFC 3986-encoded query, sent as the Signature parameter); never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_falabella_user_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_USER_ID
platform_mcp_falabella_user_id.description: Seller Center UserID: the e-mail login the API key belongs to (sent as UserID).

platform_mcp_falabella_operator_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_OPERATOR_CODE
platform_mcp_falabella_operator_code.description: Business unit to write to: facl (Chile), fape (Peru) or faco (Colombia).

platform_mcp_falabella_warehouse_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_WAREHOUSE_ID
platform_mcp_falabella_warehouse_id.description: SellerWarehouseId for set_inventory when the seller has several warehouses (GetWarehouse); leave empty with a single warehouse.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one product (GetProducts, Limit=1) to verify the UserID, API key and signature.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GetOrders (XML answer, values are strings; the order's item statuses and the Price total stay under raw.Statuses / raw.Price because an order can carry several item statuses). `since` is sent as CreatedAfter (ISO 8601); `status` is an order status code such as pending, ready_to_ship, shipped, delivered, canceled (comma-separated for several). Parameters are listed in name order because the signature covers the sorted query. Shipping an order (SetStatusToReadyToShip) needs order-item ids from GetOrderItems.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: ProductUpdate feed keyed by SellerSku (listing_id = your SellerSku) for the configured business unit (facl/fape/faco): only the fields you pass are changed (Name, Description, Price, Stock). Asynchronous: the answer is a feed RequestId; check FeedStatus in Seller Center for rejections.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: UpdateStock for one SellerSku (`sku` is required; it is your SellerSku) in the default warehouse, or in the configured SellerWarehouseId. Not for Fulfillment-by-Falabella stock. Asynchronous feed (RequestId).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: ProductRemove feed for one SellerSku (listing_id). A removed product can be restored with ProductUpdate and the Status tag (per the docs). Asynchronous feed (RequestId).
